name: B10-0082/2026 (PPE) – Conviction and imminent sentencing of Jimmy Lai in Hong Kong
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the conviction and imminent sentencing of Jimmy Lai in Hong Kong
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the immediate and unconditional release of Jimmy Lai, a 78-year-old British citizen and media entrepreneur convicted in Hong Kong under the National Security Law. It says his detention is politically motivated and unlawful, and that he has been held in solitary confinement for over 1,800 days with poor health and denied adequate medical care. The Parliament also asks Hong Kong to give him specialised medical care and calls for the release of all journalists and writers held under national security and sedition charges.

- **What changes:** Nothing directly. This is the Parliament's opinion and request, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Jimmy Lai, other detained journalists, and Hong Kong and Chinese authorities.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to European Union institutions, China and Hong Kong.
